A shrill tone which is meant to be assertive. When he sees a vacant checkout he darts toward it. Two transactions later, I meet him in the rewards section, near the loyalty-card sign-up. He's with a companion who's saying: "You should get a sturdier cart." He shows him where (at the wheels) and why it wobbles.
